stories.title: Dark energy and quantum gravity may be deeply intertwined
stories.desc: For close to a century, physicists have pursued a way to unite gravity with quantum mechanics. Known as quantum gravity, this goal has remained frustratingly out of reach so far. Similarly elusive is the force of dark energy, which is believed to be driving the universe's accelerating expansion.

stories.title: Newton's momentum principles could help design safer offshore facilities in extreme waves
stories.desc: Researchers have developed a novel model to accurately and efficiently predict the impact of "green water"—water washing onto the deck of an offshore facility during extreme wave conditions.

stories.title: Illuminating the limits of the international unit of light, the candela
stories.desc: The candela, the international unit of light in use for almost a century, forms the basis of photometry. According to a new study, measurements derived from it systematically misjudge the brightness of colored light sources and depart markedly from human perception.
